purpose: Allow narrowly governed semantic specialization of an interrogative content variable without assigning unrecovered exact WH meanings to historical tokens.

form.orthography: closed compound by default when the resulting form passes HNK phonotactic and collision checks
form.head_semantics: domain formative specializes the semantic role of the content variable

prerequisites.KU: must remain labeled as inferred content-variable component, not historical WHAT/WHERE/WHO
prerequisites.domain_formative: must have independent recovered distributional evidence for its domain role
prerequisites.result: must be an explicit AUTHORING_PROPOSAL with its own provenance and promotion gate

not_allowed_v1.reason: ON is GATE and its pronoun/referent semantics are unresolved; do not derive WHO.
SARASALA is WATCH and no compounding evidence licenses an AGE/HOW-LONG interrogative.
Final I is only a morphological correlation hypothesis, not an approved independent ACTION formative.
Sound symbolism or phonetic convenience cannot assign semantics.

validation_requirements: HNK40 strict round-trip where romanization is available
source and authoring provenance remain distinct
human approval before canonical registry application
